documentation.content: An execution of the off-host backup job clor-backup failed. Read its log for the line starting 'backup: FAILED'. Runbook: docs/BACKUP-AND-RESTORE.md.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "clor-backup" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
